units.source_text: 至于杀男人嘛，我也想公平一点。

en.t: As for killing the man, I wanted to be fair about that too.

units.source_text: 我给他松了绳子，跟他决斗。

en.t: I untied his ropes and fought him in a duel.

units.source_text: （杉树脚下的绳子，就是当时忘了带走扔掉的。）

en.t: The rope at the foot of the cedar was the one I forgot to take away and left behind then.

units.source_text: 男人脸煞白，立刻大刀出鞘。

en.t: The man turned deathly pale and immediately drew his sword.

units.source_text: 一瞬间，就沉默的扑向了我。

en.t: In an instant, he silently lunged at me.
There is no need to say much about how it ended.

units.source_text: 打到二十三个回合，我的大刀刺进了他的胸膛。

en.t: After twenty-three exchanges, my sword pierced his chest.

units.source_text: 记住——是第二十三个回合。

en.t: Remember this: it was the twenty-third exchange.

units.source_text: 到今天，我依然很佩服他。

en.t: Even today, I still admire him greatly.

units.source_text: 因为他是第一个能我交手二十个回合以上的人。

en.t: Because he was the first man who could trade more than twenty exchanges with me.

units.source_text: 男人倒下之后，我提着沾满鲜血的大刀，去找女人。

en.t: After the man fell, I carried my blood-soaked sword and went to look for the woman.

units.source_text: 没想到，女人已经跑掉了。

en.t: To my surprise, the woman had already run away.
